blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Benedicto College (BC) Cheetahs turned a tight first-half contest into a comfortable victory, pulling away in the third quarter to beat the University of Southern Philippines Foundation (USPF) Panthers, 72-60, in the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) Season 26 men’s basketball tournament on Sunday, November 15, at the Cebu Coliseum. The league-leading Cheetahs used a decisive third-quarter surge to put the game out of reach and snap back from a 63-72 loss to the CIT-U Wildcats on November 7, their most recent outing before Sunday’s game.
